Certainly! Here's a template you can use to inform customers about a delay in their courier delivery:

---

Subject: Update on Your Delivery Status

Dear [Customer's Name],

I hope this message finds you well. We are writing to inform you about the status of your recent order ([Order Number]) scheduled for delivery via [Courier Service Name].

Due to [reason for delay: e.g., high demand, weather conditions, logistical issues], your package is experiencing an unexpected delay. We are actively working with our courier partners to ensure that your order reaches you as soon as possible.

**Updated Delivery Estimate:** [New estimated delivery date]

We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience this may cause and appreciate your patience and understanding. We are committed to providing you with the best service and are focused on resolving this as quickly as possible.

If you have any questions or need further assistance, please do not hesitate to contact our customer service team at [Customer Service Email] or [Customer Service Phone Number].

Thank you for your continued trust in us.

Warm regards,

[Your Name]  
[Your Position]  
[Company Name]  
[Contact Information]  

---

Feel free to customize the details such as reasons for delays, contact information, and any other specifics relevant to your situation.
